run_evaluator: run the Evaluator CLI to evaluate ML models on benchmarks via fire.Fire
list_available_models: list all available ML models supported by the unibench evaluator
list_available_benchmarks: list all available benchmarks supported by the unibench evaluator
evaluate_models_on_benchmarks: evaluate ML models on specified benchmarks and save results to CSV
download_benchmarks: download benchmark datasets to the specified benchmarks directory
